items.note: Empty plastic water bottles go in your curbside recycling bin.
Greasy cardboard cannot be recycled because the oil contaminates the paper fibers.
Banana peels and other food scraps go in compost.
Plastic shopping bags need a specialty drop-off bin, not curbside recycling.
